text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Accompanying Nishino Flower, I came to 
watch the blooming of the "flower that 
only blooms at night" that she had been 
raising. One night—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It should be about time for it to 
bloom, and yet...—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*...
choice_data_list: Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —Ah! I-I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Um. Normally it's around my bedtime, 
so... I just—"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I want to do my best tonight...! I 
want to watch this little one bloom—"
choice_data_list:
Shall we try just a little harder 
together?

Pushing yourself too hard isn't good, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, but Trainer, please don't push 
yourself too hard! You're just going along 
with my selfishness, after all..."
choice_data_list:
Flower, make sure you don't push yourself 
too hard, okay?

Flower, make sure you don't push yourself 
too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, while casually chatting with 
Nishino Flower, we watched and waited for 
the moment of blooming, when—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: ...Flower?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —Hyah! I-I'm not asleep!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Y-You never know when a flower will bloom, 
after all. So... I'll do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower fought hard to stave off 
her sleepiness. Yet, the bud remained 
stubbornly shut as time ticked away—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, morning arrived without it 
ever blooming...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: Flower, wake up.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, it's... it's morning!? I'm so sorry, 
I fell asleep!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Flowers are—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: ...That's too bad.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'm okay! I already knew it was a 
flower that doesn't bloom easily. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The time I spent watching over this child 
together with you, Trainer... was so much 
fun!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …………Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... if you ever have the chance again, 
would you watch over this child with me 
next time?
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if the flowers didn't bloom, it felt 
as though the distance between them and 
Nishino Flower had closed just a little 
bit...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's do our best today as well!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
—I didn't want you catching a cold, so I 
brought some warm tea today. Here you go, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I drank tea with Nishino Flower 
and chatted idly as we watched and waited 
for the moment of blooming, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, morning arrived without it 
ever blooming...
choice_data_list:
It was disappointing again this time, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, I'm sure it'll bloom 
next time!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That's why—
choice_data_list: Let's watch over them together again.
Let's watch over them together again.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if the flowers didn't bloom, it felt 
as though the distance between them and 
Nishino Flower had closed just a little 
bit...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm not overdoing it at all...! As you 
can see, I'm full of energy—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah—
choice_data_list: ...Shall we take a quick nap?
...Wanna take a short nap?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Au... but...
choice_data_list:
Pulling an all-nighter really isn't good 
for you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ............ ......That's true, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Then, I'll take you up on 
that offer and get a little sleep.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, but please don't overdo it yourself 
either, Trainer...!"
choice_data_list: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, we agreed to head back, take a 
nap, and meet up again to check on the 
flowers, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Both Nishino Flower and I ended up 
sleeping in until our usual wake-up time, 
and rushed out to the field in a panic 
come morning...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. Looks like it really did bloom 
yesterday after all.
choice_data_list: Sorry...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, please! Trainer, you don't need to 
apologize at all! I fell asleep too, after 
all—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Still, it feels a little funny, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
To think that both you and I, Trainer, 
would end up sleeping right through until 
morning...
choice_data_list: We sure click in the weirdest places, huh.

We click in the strangest places, don't 
we?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Indeed♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although I missed the exact moment the 
flower bloomed, I felt as though Nishino 
Flower and I had grown a little closer—
